site.name: Accord Mine
overview: Accord Mine is a documented historic mine in Clear Creek County near Empire. USGS-derived topographic mapping preserves the named mine at approximately 39.746654, -105.668614, providing a defensible identification point without implying present-day access or surviving open workings.
moreHistory: The mapped Accord Mine is identified as an inactive gold-and-silver mine on the Georgetown, Colorado topographic quadrangle. The available retained evidence supports the mine's identity and location, but does not establish a reliable operator chronology, production total, or present condition, so those details are left unstated.
